instructions.task: A customer of a digital bank sent this message to the support chat. Which intent does the message express? Choose exactly one intent.
labelling rules (follow these): If the customer calls the transaction a transfer ('denying my transfers', 'I thought transfers were free'), choose the matching transfer intent even if they were buying something.
An error when making a large payment such as for a flat or mortgage is failed_transfer.

Waiting for a transfer to reach a recipient or retailer's account is transfer_not_received_by_recipient; waiting a long time for a transfer with no recipient mentioned, or 'when will the transaction post to my account', is pending_transfer.
Asking to check that a UK transfer made a few hours ago went through is balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.
The card was tried several times or in several places and never goes through, without the word declined: card_not_working.
Topping up explicitly with a card and the money is gone: topping_up_by_card.

Finding, receiving, or setting the PIN of the physical card (the customer mentions the physical card or a PIN that never arrived): get_physical_card. 'Help me set up a new PIN' or changing a PIN: change_pin.
Reactivating or re-adding a card the customer thought was lost: card_linking.
A beneficiary that can't receive the customer's transfer: beneficiary_not_allowed.
Hidden fees or being charged too many fees: card_payment_fee_charged.
Wanting to cancel a purchase of an item: request_refund. Wanting to take back, revert or cancel a transaction or transfer they made: cancel_transfer.
Being unable to transfer to an account ('I need to transfer to my account and can't', 'transfer not possible / not allowed'): beneficiary_not_allowed.
How disposable virtual cards work or making disposable cards: get_disposable_virtual_card.
Cash or a cash balance showing up in the app that the customer doesn't recognise: cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.
Whether a currency (e.g. EUR) is allowed or supported for exchange: fiat_currency_support.

criteria.activate_my_card: Activating a new card, or the customer cannot activate their card.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open/use an account; opening an account for children or teens.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or Apple Watch, including topping up through them.
criteria.atm_support: Finding ATMs or which ATMs accept the card (e.g. nearest Mastercard ATM).
criteria.automatic_top_up: The auto top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it up, its limits.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: A bank transfer was made or received (money sent into the account) but the balance hasn't updated / the incoming transfer isn't showing yet; also 'how long does a UK transfer take, it isn't showing'.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Money the customer deposited or put into their account (cash, cheque) isn't showing in the balance yet (e.g. 'still awaiting the money I put into my account'), or a cheque is slow to clear.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary, or a transfer to an account is not allowed / 'not possible' / the customer can't transfer to that account (even if it worked before).
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancelling, reversing or reverting a transfer or payment the customer made (including a payment sent by mistake).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired: getting a replacement, including its cost and delivery time.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card can be used / whether shops or places accept it.
criteria.card_arrival: The customer's new card has not arrived yet, or they want to track a card that was sent.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, how the card will be delivered, getting it by a certain date or fast-tracked.
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app/account, adding a card in the app, or re-linking a card the customer found after losing it.
criteria.card_not_working: The card does not work or stopped working, e.g. it did not work in several shops or the customer cannot use it, without saying a payment was declined (not at an ATM).
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee or extra amount charged for paying/purchasing with the card (the customer mentions the card, a purchase or payments having fees); complaints about hidden fees or being charged too many fees.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or charge on the statement the customer does not recognise, did not make, or says is wrong.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: An exchange rate the customer got was wrong, incorrect or bad, on a card purchase/payment or unspecified (e.g. 'the rate I got is incorrect', 'the rate in your app is really bad', 'you are ripping people off with the rate'). If the rate complaint is about getting cash / an ATM withdrawal, use wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept, ate or swallowed the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: A fee charged for withdrawing cash at an ATM (domestic; not cash abroad/foreign currency).
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer didn't make or authorise (even if they suspect their card was copied); cash shown in the app that the customer did not take or receive.
criteria.change_pin: Changing an existing PIN or setting up a new PIN (e.g. where/how to change my PIN, help me set up a new PIN).
criteria.compromised_card: The customer believes someone else has their card details or is using their card (fraud, cloned card), wants it frozen. If they name a specific card payment or cash withdrawal they didn't make, use the matching not_recognised intent instead.
criteria.country_support: Which countries are supported; using the service or having the card sent to a particular country.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment was declined or rejected (the customer says declined/rejected, or asks why a payment was declined).
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined or not authorised, or the card won't work at an ATM.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or rejected: the customer uses the word declined/rejected about their transfer(s).
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise or did not set up.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits/restrictions on disposable virtual cards (how many uses, what they can do).
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details or account information (name, address, etc.).
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees, charges or costs for exchanging currency, including whether frequent exchangers get a better/discounted rate.
criteria.exchange_rate: Neutral information requests about what the exchange rates are or how they are set; not complaints that a rate was wrong or bad.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app; what currencies can be exchanged to.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: The customer was charged an extra amount on top ('why was I charged extra?'), typically a small £1/$1/€1 amount or an extra pound paid over the price. Not a payment that is wrong or unknown, and not an extra fee for paying with the card (that is card_payment_fee_charged).
criteria.failed_transfer: A bank transfer failed or keeps failing; the customer can't make a transfer go through (not top-ups).
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding and exchanging.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Getting/ordering a disposable virtual card; who can get one.
criteria.get_physical_card: PIN questions for a physical card: PIN not received, can't find the PIN, where the PIN is, how to set the physical card's PIN.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/second/spare card, including fees and how many cards one can have.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Getting a virtual card, where to find it, or a virtual card that hasn't been received.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card was lost or stolen.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The customer's phone was lost, stolen or left behind and they need to use/secure the account.
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical/plastic card; fees for a physical card; where cards can be delivered.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode or login code; resetting it.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment/purchase is still pending.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is pending or shows as in progress (e.g. ATM failed but transaction in progress).
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending or taking a long time to complete.
criteria.pending_transfer: A specific transfer is pending, or the customer has been waiting a long time / forever for a transfer ('why is my transfer taking so long', 'how much longer').
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked or account/card blocked after entering the wrong PIN too many times.
criteria.receiving_money: Whether/how other people can send money to the customer, including in other currencies.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the customer is expecting has not appeared in their account yet.
criteria.request_refund: The customer wants to request/get a refund for something they bought.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was returned/reverted back to the account, e.g. money was deducted and then came back, or the seller says the payment didn't go through.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (card brands such as American Express, credit cards) and currencies are supported, e.g. for adding money; why a particular card brand doesn't work for top-up.
criteria.terminate_account: Closing, deleting or terminating the account; no longer wanting to be a customer.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer; any SWIFT or SEPA question.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up with a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque, depositing cash/cheques.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined, gave an error, or the customer is unsure it went through ('pop-up' or 'top off' are misspellings of top-up).
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-up amounts or number of top-ups.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up went through and then was reverted / the money disappeared again.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up with a card; problems topping up with a card.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment was charged twice (double charge).
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee charged on a transfer (including when the customer says they thought transfers were free); also bare questions about charges with no transaction named ('why was I charged?', 'will I get extra charges?') and fees for using the account abroad.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to add money to the account by transferring from another account; general questions about what ways or methods there are to add money to the account (when the customer does not say 'top up').
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: An outgoing transfer the customer sent has not arrived: the recipient hasn't got it, or the money is 'not there / not here yet' / 'not showing up'; also vague complaints that a 'transaction' is taking too long to complete.
criteria.transfer_timing: General questions about how long transfers take (e.g. from the US or Europe), not about a specific transfer the customer just made that isn't showing.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: The customer tried to verify their identity but it failed or they can't complete it.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity, what documents are needed, how long verification takes.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Seeing or verifying the source of funds / where money came from; seeing one's available money.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or top-up card; finding the top-up verification code.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card does not work.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Visa vs Mastercard: which brand the card is, or choosing one.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification or personal information is required.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM gave the wrong amount of cash.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong, too high or bad exchange rate on a cash withdrawal or when getting cash (e.g. 'this should have been a much higher amount of cash', 'what are weekend rates for getting cash'); any question about fees, costs or rates for withdrawing cash abroad, on holiday or in a foreign/home currency.

transaction_charged_twice.customer is asking about: The same payment was charged twice (double charge).

extra_charge_on_statement.customer is asking about: The customer was charged an extra amount on top ('why was I charged extra?'), typically a small £1/$1/€1 amount or an extra pound paid over the price. Not a payment that is wrong or unknown, and not an extra fee for paying with the card (that is card_payment_fee_charged).

direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.customer is asking about: A direct debit the customer does not recognise or did not set up.

atm_support.customer is asking about: Finding ATMs or which ATMs accept the card (e.g. nearest Mastercard ATM).

cash_withdrawal_charge.customer is asking about: A fee charged for withdrawing cash at an ATM (domestic; not cash abroad/foreign currency).

cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.customer is asking about: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer didn't make or authorise (even if they suspect their card was copied); cash shown in the app that the customer did not take or receive.

declined_cash_withdrawal.customer is asking about: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined or not authorised, or the card won't work at an ATM.

pending_cash_withdrawal.customer is asking about: A cash withdrawal is pending or shows as in progress (e.g. ATM failed but transaction in progress).

wrong_amount_of_cash_received.customer is asking about: The ATM gave the wrong amount of cash.

wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal.customer is asking about: Wrong, too high or bad exchange rate on a cash withdrawal or when getting cash (e.g. 'this should have been a much higher amount of cash', 'what are weekend rates for getting cash'); any question about fees, costs or rates for withdrawing cash abroad, on holiday or in a foreign/home currency.

Refund_not_showing_up.customer is asking about: A refund the customer is expecting has not appeared in their account yet.

request_refund.customer is asking about: The customer wants to request/get a refund for something they bought.

balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.customer is asking about: A bank transfer was made or received (money sent into the account) but the balance hasn't updated / the incoming transfer isn't showing yet; also 'how long does a UK transfer take, it isn't showing'.

beneficiary_not_allowed.customer is asking about: Cannot add a beneficiary, or a transfer to an account is not allowed / 'not possible' / the customer can't transfer to that account (even if it worked before).

cancel_transfer.customer is asking about: Cancelling, reversing or reverting a transfer or payment the customer made (including a payment sent by mistake).

declined_transfer.customer is asking about: A transfer was declined or rejected: the customer uses the word declined/rejected about their transfer(s).

failed_transfer.customer is asking about: A bank transfer failed or keeps failing; the customer can't make a transfer go through (not top-ups).

pending_transfer.customer is asking about: A specific transfer is pending, or the customer has been waiting a long time / forever for a transfer ('why is my transfer taking so long', 'how much longer').

receiving_money.customer is asking about: Whether/how other people can send money to the customer, including in other currencies.

transfer_fee_charged.customer is asking about: A fee charged on a transfer (including when the customer says they thought transfers were free); also bare questions about charges with no transaction named ('why was I charged?', 'will I get extra charges?') and fees for using the account abroad.

transfer_into_account.customer is asking about: How to add money to the account by transferring from another account; general questions about what ways or methods there are to add money to the account (when the customer does not say 'top up').

transfer_not_received_by_recipient.customer is asking about: An outgoing transfer the customer sent has not arrived: the recipient hasn't got it, or the money is 'not there / not here yet' / 'not showing up'; also vague complaints that a 'transaction' is taking too long to complete.

transfer_timing.customer is asking about: General questions about how long transfers take (e.g. from the US or Europe), not about a specific transfer the customer just made that isn't showing.

automatic_top_up.customer is asking about: The auto top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it up, its limits.

balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash.customer is asking about: Money the customer deposited or put into their account (cash, cheque) isn't showing in the balance yet (e.g. 'still awaiting the money I put into my account'), or a cheque is slow to clear.

pending_top_up.customer is asking about: A top-up is pending or taking a long time to complete.

supported_cards_and_currencies.customer is asking about: Which cards (card brands such as American Express, credit cards) and currencies are supported, e.g. for adding money; why a particular card brand doesn't work for top-up.

top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge.customer is asking about: Fees for topping up by bank transfer; any SWIFT or SEPA question.

top_up_by_card_charge.customer is asking about: Fees for topping up with a card.

top_up_by_cash_or_cheque.customer is asking about: Topping up with cash or a cheque, depositing cash/cheques.

top_up_failed.customer is asking about: A top-up failed, was declined, gave an error, or the customer is unsure it went through ('pop-up' or 'top off' are misspellings of top-up).

top_up_limits.customer is asking about: Limits on top-up amounts or number of top-ups.

top_up_reverted.customer is asking about: A top-up went through and then was reverted / the money disappeared again.

topping_up_by_card.customer is asking about: How to top up with a card; problems topping up with a card.

verify_top_up.customer is asking about: Verifying a top-up or top-up card; finding the top-up verification code.

exchange_charge.customer is asking about: Fees, charges or costs for exchanging currency, including whether frequent exchangers get a better/discounted rate.

exchange_rate.customer is asking about: Neutral information requests about what the exchange rates are or how they are set; not complaints that a rate was wrong or bad.

exchange_via_app.customer is asking about: How to exchange currencies in the app; what currencies can be exchanged to.

fiat_currency_support.customer is asking about: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding and exchanging.

age_limit.customer is asking about: Minimum age to open/use an account; opening an account for children or teens.

edit_personal_details.customer is asking about: Changing personal details or account information (name, address, etc.).

lost_or_stolen_phone.customer is asking about: The customer's phone was lost, stolen or left behind and they need to use/secure the account.

passcode_forgotten.customer is asking about: Forgot the app passcode or login code; resetting it.

terminate_account.customer is asking about: Closing, deleting or terminating the account; no longer wanting to be a customer.

unable_to_verify_identity.customer is asking about: The customer tried to verify their identity but it failed or they can't complete it.

verify_my_identity.customer is asking about: How to verify identity, what documents are needed, how long verification takes.

verify_source_of_funds.customer is asking about: Seeing or verifying the source of funds / where money came from; seeing one's available money.

why_verify_identity.customer is asking about: Why identity verification or personal information is required.
